nodes.title: Safety judge candidate: GPT-4.1 mini on the regional South India deployment, the only model measured inside the 800 ms judge budget (recall 29/30, FP 4/90, p95 480 ms, INR 21.6 per 1k turns). It stays in shadow mode.
nodes.rationale: FP 4/90 (4.4%) per benign caller turn would add a crisis line to roughly a third of ordinary 10-turn calls. On held-out set 6 the floor already catches 30/30, so the judge's added recall is not measured there. The set that matters is BLIND 7, where the floor catches 37/100.
nodes.reverse_if: On BLIND 7 the judge lifts crisis recall well above the floor's 37/100, with FP at or below 1% on benign turns (n large enough that the upper CI bound is at or below 2%), and the owner approves raise mode.
